_comment: Quality floors for fbtberger-raft. Both numbers may only go UP -- see the kwatro repository's QUALITY.md. Pitest is pointed at the arithmetic the protocol rests on (Quorum, RaftConfig, storage), not at RaftNode: one mutant there means booting a cluster.
_coverage_note: The floor is 0.80 against a measured 80.9 %. Two things changed on 2026-08-30. First, the report no longer counts protoc output: two thirds of this repository by line count is generated (6287 of 9113 lines), it sat at 30.9 %, and together with the hand-written 81.3 % it produced the 46 % that used to be the headline. That number moved with the size of the .proto files rather than with the tests. Second, the tests stopped sleeping: fixed waits were replaced by conditions and, where the code has an event to signal, by latches on the RPC seam. Measured before: 344 tests, no failures, no skips, and line coverage moving between 4199 and 4214 from run to run. Measured after, over four forced re-runs: 2284, 2285, 2284, 2285 -- a spread of one line. The margin to 0.80 is for that one line and no more; raise it when a run is worth pinning.
